source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of graph algorithms (PDF 86).

blocks.text: Graph algorithms graphs ko explore karne (dhoondne aur dekhne) aur un ka analysis karne ke liye istemal hote hain. Graph aisa data structure hai jo edges (jorne wali lakeeron) se jure nodes (vertices, points) se bana hota hai. Yeh algorithms network analysis, route planning (raasta tay karna) aur social network analysis ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Sarkon ke naqshe ko graph samjhein to nodes aur edges kya honge?
blocks.explanation: Nodes jagahein (jaise shehar ya chowk) aur edges unhein jorne wali sarkein.

items: Graph: edges se jure nodes (vertices); networks, raaston aur social networks mein istemal.
